aboutUs: We are delighted to have you explore our lab, where cutting-edge research meets innovation in the realms of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS). At AIMS Lab, we are committed to pushing the boundaries of AI by developing intelligent systems capable of autonomous decision-making, cooperation, and negotiation. Our research spans various domains, including autonomous systems, cooperative agent, robotics, large language model and generative AI. Equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and a collaborative environment, we foster creativity and innovation among our diverse team of researchers. Join us as we delve into the exciting advancements in AI and MAS, and work together to shape the future of intelligent systems.

Situated within the prestigious Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad (IIIT-A), our lab benefits from the institute's rich academic culture and its dedication to excellence in research and education. IIIT Allahabad is renowned for its focus on information technology and allied fields, providing an intellectually stimulating environment that nurtures innovation and interdisciplinary collaboration. Our lab thrives within this ecosystem, drawing on IIIT-A's strengths to explore novel solutions to global challenges in AI and Multi-Agent Systems.

carousel.title: Consensun Model
carousel.description: This project focuses on consensus and obstacle avoidance in swarm robotics using various models, including the voter model, HK model, and majority rule model. The objective is to simulate and analyze how different decision-making strategies can be applied to swarms to achieve efficient navigation and obstacle avoidance.

carousel.title: Snake AI
carousel.description: SNAKE_AI is an AI-driven implementation of the classic Snake game. The project utilizes the Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm, a reinforcement learning technique, to train an intelligent agent capable of mastering the game. The agent learns to navigate the game grid, collect food, grow in length, and avoid collisions with itself and obstacles, demonstrating strategic gameplay and achieving high scores.
